corewriter_action_accepted_locally_occur.meaning: a CoreWriter action sent by executeHedge()/supplyToBlp() was accepted locally while the corresponding 0x811 supplied slot does not exist or is not yet active on HyperCore

pm_enabled.meaning: pmEnabled is true when executeHedge() runs

backing_reads_available.meaning: totalBackingSigned() and the accounting reads depending on it complete without reverting for the registered supplied-slot set
backing_reads_available.checkpoint: after slot registration, during accounting reads

accounting_availability_impacted.meaning: protocol accounting and settlement availability is impacted through a plausible normal Operator/CoreWriter flow
accounting_availability_impacted.checkpoint: after slot registration, during accounting/settlement reads

assumptions: executeHedge()/supplyToBlp() are invoked through a plausible normal Operator/CoreWriter flow; no authorization condition is claimed.
The premature/inactive 0x811 slot scenario is treated as the report-supported conditional case, not an observed transaction.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify whether the unreadable 0x811 slot is transient or permanent, nor the exact prior registry state before the action; the availability impact is only potential.

limitations: Formalizes only the potential availability impact of protocol_accounting_availability_impacted; the separate revert impact core_accounting_reads_revert is not covered by this plan.
backing_reads_available and accounting_availability_impacted are qualitative Booleans because the report gives no numeric definition of availability.
The potential modality is preserved by treating the scenario as conditional on the locally-accepted-but-unreadable slot trigger.
